Run the L0 to L1 to L2 site pipeline backbone

Source: R/proc.R
dm_run_pipeline.Rd

Shared backbone for site processing scripts: validates the L0 input, processes L1 and L2 via 'treenetproc' (optionally with a temperature L1), and writes RDS outputs to the supplied directories. Requires the suggested package 'treenetproc'. run_L1_L2() is the original DendroMatic name, kept as an exported alias.

Usage

run_L1_L2(
  L0_long,
  reso_min,
  site_tag,
  out_dir_L0,
  out_dir_L1,
  out_dir_L2,
  temp_L1 = NULL,
  tz_use = "UTC",
  write_per_series = FALSE,
  raw_dir = file.path(out_dir_L0, paste0(site_tag, "_RAW")),
  l0_fname = paste0(site_tag, "_L0_long.rds"),
  l1_fname = paste0(site_tag, "_L1.rds"),
  l2_fname = paste0(site_tag, "_L2_auto.rds")
)

dm_run_pipeline(
  L0_long,
  reso_min,
  site_tag,
  out_dir_L0,
  out_dir_L1,
  out_dir_L2,
  temp_L1 = NULL,
  tz_use = "UTC",
  write_per_series = FALSE,
  raw_dir = file.path(out_dir_L0, paste0(site_tag, "_RAW")),
  l0_fname = paste0(site_tag, "_L0_long.rds"),
  l1_fname = paste0(site_tag, "_L1.rds"),
  l2_fname = paste0(site_tag, "_L2_auto.rds")
)

Arguments

L0_long

L0 long data.frame (series, ts, value).

reso_min

Measurement resolution in minutes.

site_tag

Site code used in output filenames (e.g. "HOL").

out_dir_L0, out_dir_L1, out_dir_L2

Output directories for the L0, L1 and L2 RDS files. All writes go only to these user-supplied paths.

temp_L1

Optional temperature L1 object for proc_dendro_L2.

tz_use

Timezone used throughout.

write_per_series

If TRUE, additionally writes one RDS per series.

raw_dir

Directory for per-series raw dumps.

l0_fname, l1_fname, l2_fname

Output filenames.

Value

Invisibly, a list with elements L0, L1 and L2.
